enunciado: She ____ to the gym every morning before work.
comentario: Com sujeito na terceira pessoa do singular (she) e hábito, o presente simples leva -s/-es: goes.

enunciado: By the time we arrived, the movie ____.
comentario: Ação concluída antes de outro ponto no passado pede o past perfect: had already started.
Dia da semana usa on; hora exata usa at.

enunciado: If I ____ more time, I would learn another language.
comentario: Segunda condicional (situação improvável): if + passado simples, would + verbo.

enunciado: In English, the word "actually" most nearly means:
"I need to attend the meeting" means that I need to:
comentario: Attend = comparecer, assistir. Atender o telefone = answer the phone.

enunciado: Please ____ the lights when you leave the room.
comentario: Turn off = desligar. Turn up = aumentar; turn into = transformar-se; turn over = virar.

enunciado: We had to ____ the trip because of the storm.

Text: "Remote work saves commuting time and lowers costs, but many workers say they miss casual talks with colleagues."

What is the main idea?
alternativas: Remote work has advantages and a social drawback.
comentario: O texto lista vantagens (tempo e custo) e uma desvantagem (menos conversas informais).

enunciado:
Text: "The museum is free on Sundays, but tickets must be booked online in advance."

What must a visitor do on Sunday?
comentario: Free não significa sem reserva: os ingressos devem ser reservados online antes.

enunciado:
Text: "Tom looked at the empty fridge, sighed, and picked up his keys."

What will Tom probably do next?
comentario: Geladeira vazia + pegar as chaves sugere sair para comprar comida.

enunciado:
Text: "Despite the rain, thousands of fans stayed until the final song."

What does "despite" suggest?
alternativas: The rain did not stop the fans.
comentario: Despite = apesar de: contraste entre a chuva e a permanência dos fãs.
